Package com.elotouch.elopay.library

Class EloPeripheralManager.ExtLed

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.elotouch.elopay.library.EloPeripheralManager.ExtLed
  • Enclosing class:
    EloPeripheralManager
    public class EloPeripheralManager.ExtLed
extends java.lang.Object
    the class to control the Status Light Kit (SLK) device, such as power mode and LED color.

    These models support Status Light Kit feature:

    "i4_in10_std" (i-series 4.0)

    "i4_in15_std" (i-series 4.0)

    "i4_in22_std" (i-series 4.0)

    Notes:

    For i-series 4.0, connect Status Light Kit (SLK) device via micro-usb port or GPIO port.

    • Method Detail

      • enableSlk

        public void enableSlk​(boolean enable)
        Request to enable/disable Status Light Kit (SLK) device.

        When SLK is disabled, android platform will ignore all requests about SLK.

        Parameters:
        enable - is a boolean representing the state that you are requesting, true for enabled, false for disabled.

      • isEnabled

        public boolean isEnabled()
        Indicates whether Status Light Kit (SLK) is enabled.

        When SLK is disabled, android platform will ignore all requests about SLK.

        Returns:
        true if Status Light Kit (SLK) is enabled

      • setPower

        public void setPower​(int portsMask,
                     int newStatus,
                     @Nullable
                     android.os.Message onComplete)
        Request to update power of Status Light Kit (SLK) with ports group

        Note: if Status Light Kit (SLK) is not enabled, ignore this request directly.

        Parameters:
        portsMask - is the mask of the port list that you are requesting to update its power, and its new status is provided by param newStatus.
        newStatus - is the power status bits of the port list
        onComplete - a callback message when the action is completed.if onComplete is null, don't send callback message when completed.

      • setColor

        public void setColor​(int portsMask,
                     int color)
        Set the color of Status Light Kit (SLK).

        Note: if Status Light Kit (SLK) is not enabled, ignore this request directly.

        Parameters:
        portsMask - is the mask of the port list that you are requesting to update its color, and its new color is provided by param color. mask defined in EloPeripheralManager.ExtLed
        color - one of EXT_LED_COLOR_XXX define in EloPeripheralManager.ExtLed.

        for i-series, pull USB trigger pin high or low to control the color of SLK.

        for i-series VALUE, pull GPIO_IFACE_IN_1 high or low to control the color of SLK.
